name: Toolbar designer help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Toolbar designer plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Toolbar designer
entries.text: Opens the designer for one of the three toolbars. Right-click any toolbar → Customize toolbar does the same.

entries.title: Toolbar
entries.text: Which of the three toolbars you are editing.

entries.title: Find
entries.text: Filters the items on the left by name or by where they come from.

entries.title: Opens in
entries.text: Where tapping this item opens its app: the main area, a floating window, or a pane beside the current one (IDE mode; it floats while IDE mode is off).

entries.title: Move up
entries.text: Moves the item one place earlier on the toolbar.

entries.title: Move down
entries.text: Moves the item one place later on the toolbar.

entries.title: Try it
entries.text: Runs the item now, the way the toolbar will.

entries.title: Save toolbar
entries.text: Saves the list on the right as this toolbar's items. The toolbar changes at once.

entries.title: Toolbar designer
entries.text: Pick what a toolbar holds, from every app and screen, and where each item opens.
